description: What does credit at this tenor and LTV cost across every venue Aletheia covers? One row per venue in coverage-matrix order — no ranking, no default sort, no "best".

class.description: Restrict to one credit class. The full matrix is ~160 rows; one class is far lighter.

ltv.description: Loan-to-value as a decimal 0–1, not a percentage.

side.description: 'borrow' (what a borrower pays, the default) or 'lend' (what a capital provider earns).

tenor_days.description: Loan term in days to compare at.

venues.description: Comma-separated registry ids to restrict the rows to, e.g. 'aave_v3_ethereum,cefi_ledn'.

name: compare_venues
title: Credit cost across venues
